newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end down on profit-taking.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed lower on profit-taking ending five days of market rally, brokers said.

The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) dropped 7.29 points or 0.34 percent at 2,128.13 on a turnover of 323.4 million taka. Of the 97 issues traded, 51 lost, 43 gained and three remained unchanged.

"There was limited market correction. Investors have started to cash gains after a sharp rise of share prices over the past few sessions," said one broker. Bangladesh Tobacco lost 20.19 taka to 312.46, Shine Pukur Holdings lost 7.32 to 194.99 and Apex Tannery rose 23.15 to 960.91.
